offline.a: No. Everything runs on your device and works in airplane mode. The only time Linewise goes online is to check for a new version, and nothing about you or your texts is sent. In the Android app you can turn that off in Settings.

chunks.q: How do I split a text into chunks?
chunks.a: Leave a blank line between chunks when you add or edit the text. Single line breaks inside a chunk are kept, which suits poems and lyrics.

script.q: How do I add a play or script?
script.a: Choose “Script” as the kind of text. Write each speaker's name in CAPITAL LETTERS on its own line, with their lines underneath. Stage directions go in (brackets) or [square brackets].

review.a: After your first scored game, reviews are spaced 1, 2, 4, 7, 14, 30 and 60 days apart. On a review day, your first Solidify or Evaluate game counts. Score 80% or more to move to the next interval; otherwise try again tomorrow.

target.a: It is the day you want to know the text by. Linewise squeezes or stretches your review gaps so the last review lands on that day.

score.q: How is my score worked out?
score.a: Accuracy multiplied by coverage. Coverage is the share of the whole text you practised in that game, so a full run of the whole text scores highest.

speech.q: Speak and Run Scene do not work. Why?
speech.a: They need the microphone, an on-device speech recogniser and the offline speech pack for your language. Linewise tells you which one is missing and how to fix it.

voices.q: How do I get a better voice?
voices.a: Open Settings, then Choose voices, then Open voice settings. Pick your speech engine and install extra voices or higher quality voice data.

backup.q: How do I move my data to a new phone?
backup.a: Use Settings, then Back up and restore. Save the backup file somewhere you can reach from the new phone, then restore it there.

recordings.q: Why are my recordings missing after a restore?
recordings.a: Backups do not include recordings, to keep the file small. Record them again on the new phone.

share.q: Can I add text from another app?
share.a: Yes. Select text in any app, choose Share, and pick Linewise. The Add screen opens with the text filled in.

camera.q: Why can't I scan Arabic or Hebrew?
camera.a: The on-device text recognition Linewise uses does not include those languages yet. You can type or paste them instead.

folders.q: How do I group texts into folders?
folders.a: On the Memorize tab, tap “New folder”, give it a name, then tick the texts that belong in it. You can also open a text and tap “Folder”. A text is in one folder at a time. Deleting a folder keeps its texts. Search and tags look through every folder.
